data.title: Add StoreMode enum for dual-mode operation
data.body:
## Summary

Add StoreMode enum to support both filesystem (legacy) and state-branch (new) storage modes.

## Implementation

In `src/store.rs`:

```rust
pub enum StoreMode {
    /// Legacy: .docket in working tree
    FileSystem { root: PathBuf },
    /// New: .docket on orphan state branch
    StateBranch { repo_root: PathBuf },
}

pub struct Store {
    pub mode: StoreMode,
    // ... existing fields ...
}
```

Update `Store::open()` to detect mode:
1. Find repo root (look for .jj or .git)
2. Check if docket-state bookmark exists → StateBranch
3. Check if .docket directory exists → FileSystem
4. Neither → error

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] StoreMode enum defined
- [ ] Store struct includes mode field
- [ ] Store::open() detects mode correctly
- [ ] Existing filesystem behavior unchanged
- [ ] Tests for mode detection
